summary: The case involves a dispute over the retrospective revision of licence fees by the New Mangalore Port Trust (NMPT) for the period 20.02.2007 to 23.07.2010. The Licensees challenged the demand for arrears, arguing that the matter was pending before the High Court. The Estate Officer issued notices under the Public Premises (Eviction of Unauthorised Occupants) Act, 1971, leading to appellate proceedings. The District Judge quashed the demand on grounds of limitation, a decision upheld by the Karnataka High Court. NMPT appealed to the Supreme Court, contending that limitation was not pleaded initially and that acknowledgment of debt extended the limitation period under Section 18 of the Limitation Act. The Supreme Court considered whether recovery proceedings under the PP Act are time-barred and if acknowledgment resets the limitation period.
